fn index_of(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Int
  requires contains(xs, x)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result < len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (index_of([4, 7, 9], 7) == 1)
  example (index_of([3, 3, 3], 3) == 0)
  example (index_of([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 3) == 2)
  example (index_of([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 1) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then 0 else (1 + index_of(t, x)) }
}

fn int_sqrt(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (((result * result) <= n) and (((result + 1) * (result + 1)) > n))
  effects pure
  example (int_sqrt(0) == 0)
  example (int_sqrt(1) == 1)
  example (int_sqrt(4) == 2)
  example (int_sqrt(16) == 4)
  example (int_sqrt(17) == 4)
{
  sqrt_helper(n, 0, (n + 1))
}

fn sqrt_helper(n: Int, low: Int, high: Int) -> Int
  requires (((((n >= 0) and (low >= 0)) and (high > low)) and ((low * low) <= n)) and ((high * high) > n))
  ensures (((result * result) <= n) and (((result + 1) * (result + 1)) > n))
  effects pure
  example (sqrt_helper(0, 0, 1) == 0)
  example (sqrt_helper(16, 0, 17) == 4)
  example (sqrt_helper(17, 0, 18) == 4)
{
  if ((high - low) == 1) then low else mid_check(n, low, high, ((low + high) / 2))
}

fn mid_check(n: Int, low: Int, high: Int, mid: Int) -> Int
  requires ((((((n >= 0) and (low >= 0)) and (high > low)) and (mid == ((low + high) / 2))) and ((low * low) <= n)) and ((high * high) > n))
  ensures (((result * result) <= n) and (((result + 1) * (result + 1)) > n))
  effects pure
  example (mid_check(16, 0, 17, 8) == 4)
  example (mid_check(17, 0, 18, 9) == 4)
{
  if ((mid * mid) <= n) then sqrt_helper(n, mid, high) else sqrt_helper(n, low, mid)
}

  ensures ((((result == a) or (result == b)) and (result >= a)) and (result >= b))
  effects pure
  example (max2(3, 5) == 5)
  example (max2(-1, -2) == -1)
{
  if (a >= b) then a else b
}

fn head(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  effects pure
  example (head([5, 6, 7]) == 5)
  example (head([9]) == 9)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => h }
}

fn tail(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - 1))
  effects pure
  example (tail([1, 2, 3]) == [2, 3])
  example (tail([9]) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => t }
}

fn start_sum_le(xs: List[Int], bound: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures (not result or (head(xs) <= bound))
  effects pure
  example (start_sum_le([1, -2, 3, 4, -1], 7) == true)
  example (start_sum_le([4, -1], 4) == true)
  example (start_sum_le([4, -1], 3) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => true [h, ..t] => match t { [] => (h <= bound) [_, .._] => ((h <= bound) and start_sum_le((bound - h), t)) } }
}

fn start_sum_eq(xs: List[Int], target: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures (not (result and (len(xs) == 1)) or (head(xs) == target))

{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => match t { [] => (h == target) [_, .._] => ((h == target) or start_sum_eq(t, (target - h))) } }
}

fn sub_sum_le(xs: List[Int], bound: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures (not result or start_sum_le(xs, bound))
  effects pure

  example (sub_sum_le([2, 2, -5, 1], 3) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => true [h, ..t] => match t { [] => start_sum_le(xs, bound) [_, .._] => (start_sum_le(xs, bound) and sub_sum_le(t, bound)) } }
}

  ensures (not start_sum_eq(xs, target) or result)

  ensures ((((result == a) or (result == b)) and (result >= a)) and (result >= b))
  effects pure
  example (max2(3, 5) == 5)
  example (max2(-1, -2) == -1)
{
  if (a >= b) then a else b
}

fn head(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  effects pure
  example (head([5, 6, 7]) == 5)
  example (head([9]) == 9)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => h }
}

fn tail(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - 1))
  effects pure
  example (tail([1, 2, 3]) == [2, 3])
  example (tail([9]) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => t }
}

fn start_sum_le(xs: List[Int], bound: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures (not result or (head(xs) <= bound))
  effects pure
  example (start_sum_le([1, -2, 3, 4, -1], 7) == true)
  example (start_sum_le([4, -1], 4) == true)
  example (start_sum_le([4, -1], 3) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => true [h, ..t] => match t { [] => (h <= bound) [_, .._] => ((h <= bound) and start_sum_le(t, (bound - h))) } }
}

fn start_sum_eq(xs: List[Int], target: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures (not (result and (len(xs) == 1)) or (head(xs) == target))

  example (start_sum_eq([4, -1], 4) == true)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => match t { [] => (h == target) [_, .._] => ((h == target) or start_sum_eq(t, (target - h))) } }
}

fn sub_sum_le(xs: List[Int], bound: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures (not result or start_sum_le(xs, bound))
  effects pure
  example (sub_sum_le([1, -2, 3, 4, -1], 7) == true)
  example (sub_sum_le([2, 2, -5, 1], 3) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => true [h, ..t] => match t { [] => start_sum_le(xs, bound) [_, .._] => (start_sum_le(bound, xs) and sub_sum_le(t, bound)) } }
}

fn sub_sum_eq(xs: List[Int], target: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures (not start_sum_eq(xs, target) or result)

  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures start_sum_le(xs, result)

fn max(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall x in xs: (x <= result)
  effects pure
  example (max([3, 9, 1]) == 9)
  example (max([5]) == 5)
  example (max([1, 2]) == 2)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => match t { [] => h [h2, ..t2] => if (h >= max(t)) then h else max(t) } }
}

fn remove_one(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires contains(xs, v)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - 1))
  ensures forall x in result: contains(xs, x)
  ensures forall x in xs: ((x == v) or contains(result, x))
  effects pure
  example (remove_one([3, 9, 1], 9) == [3, 1])
  example (remove_one([4], 4) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h == v) then t else ([h] ++ remove_one(t, v)) }
}

  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures is_pointwise_sum(xs, ys, result)
  effects pure
  example (zip_sum([1, 2, 3], [10, 20, 30]) == [11, 22, 33])
  example (zip_sum([], []) == [])
  example (zip_sum([5], [7]) == [12])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [hx, ..tx] => match ys { [] => [] [hy, ..ty] => ([(hx + hy)] ++ zip_sum(tx, ty)) } }
}

fn is_pointwise_sum(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int], result: List[Int]) -> Bool
  requires ((len(xs) == len(ys)) and (len(ys) == len(result)))
  ensures ((result == true) or (result == false))
  effects pure
  example (is_pointwise_sum([1, 2], [3, 4], [4, 6]) == true)
  example (is_pointwise_sum([1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]) == false)
  example (is_pointwise_sum([], [], []) == true)
{
  match xs { [] => match ys { [] => match result { [] => true [_, .._] => false } [_, .._] => false } [hx, ..tx] => match ys { [] => false [hy, ..ty] => match result { [] => false [hr, ..tr] => ((hr == (hx + hy)) and is_pointwise_sum(tx, tr, tr)) } } }
}
